purpose: Machine-readable spatial/depth lithology evidence model for SONDI.BG. It preserves conditional spatial and structural rules and must not invent exact geological contacts where geometry is unavailable.

confidence_semantics.HIGH: Strong regional or spatially conditioned model.
confidence_semantics.MEDIUM: Regional/structural interpretation with unresolved local geometry.
confidence_semantics.LOW: Broad model with major unresolved structural ambiguity.

VRA-Z01.name: Козлодуйска низина / Радиана / АЕЦ

sequence.probable_material: alluvial, eolian and eolian-alluvial deposits; terrace-dependent gravel, sand, clay and loess
dense yellowish clays with calcareous concretions; locally sandy with clayey-sand intercalations
grey-bluish sandy clays and sands; locally lignitic coal horizons and sandy clays

shallow_spatial_model.guard: Published 3D model architecture is valid evidence, but exact model top/bottom grids are not currently machine-readable. Do not apply local layer boundaries outside documented model geometry.

depth_summary.material: Brusartsi Formation clay with local sand beds

local_templates.sequence: soil → loess/loess-like clay → gravel → Brusartsi clay and sands

VRA-Z01.fallback_rule: If no local model selector is resolved, use the regional Cenozoic sequence and zone confidence only. Do not invent exact contacts.

VRA-Z02.name: Северна льосово-алувиална равнина
absolute_guards: Do not invent exact base-Neogene depth from regional trend.
Do not convert formation thickness directly into depth below ground.
Do not smooth through the Byala Slatina depression.
Do not smooth across mapped fault blocks.
Test Paleo-Skat/paleorelief context before deep assignment.

rules.probable: Quaternary loess/alluvium; locally transition toward Neogene
Quaternary in thick-cover sectors OR Neogene where cover is thinner
older substrate possible; structural control required

OSTROV_LOWLAND.rule: Do not apply plateau loess template.

sequence.material: sandstones, dark-bedded limestones and calcareous clays

Бяла Слатина.guard: Exact formation depth requires structural/seismic surface integration.

rules.probable: red clay or Neogene depending on local loess thickness
loess/red clay OR Neogene depending on local cover
Neogene OR Cretaceous depending on structure
older platform cover; exact unit unresolved

formations.thickness_m: up to 143 around Oryahovo; typically 40-50 eastward

regional_formation_thickness.guard: Thickness is not depth below ground.

paleovalley_guard.effect: Neogene fill may be hundreds of metres thicker than on adjacent structural highs.

VRA-Z03.name: Криводол / Враца – Западен Предбалкан

rules.20_m: weathered or fresh marl depending on local surface-cover thickness

rules.200_m: carbonate complex OR adjacent/underlying marl depending on facies and thickness

rules.300_m: near/below unit base depending on local thickness

facies_guards: Botunya is a lateral facies equivalent of the Vratsa Urgonian carbonate group.
Botunya thins westward and pinches out.
West of Krivodol, Botunya is replaced by Mramoren marl.
Sumer may overlie either Mramoren or Urgonian units depending on structural/facies position.
Do not interpolate linearly through these transitions.

fallback_output_when_surface_polygon_unk.note: Exact alternative must not be selected until surface geological polygon and structural/facies position are resolved.

formation_observations.caution: depth to occurrence; not a fully specified interval
locality and full identifier must be verified

restrictions: Formation thicknesses are not measured depth intervals.
R-51 Ponora is a separate analogue and is excluded from this local group.
No unverified well coordinates or exact contacts.

local_quaternary_cover.description: преотложен льос и песъчливи слабо варовити глини; локално отмити

upper_glauconitic_horizon.description: светлозелени до тревистозелени средно- и едрозърнести глауконитови пясъчници

lower_glauconitic_horizon.description: по-плътни тъмнозелени до сивозелени пясъчници; местни дребнозърнести, глинести пластове и аргилити

restrictions: Regional formation thickness is not local depth.

VRA-Z04.name: Мездра / Роман – синклинален пояс

regional_sequence.material: micritic/flint-bearing limestone with local marl intervals

rules.0_50_m: predominantly micritic/flint-bearing limestone; locally argillaceous limestone/marl
rules.50_100_m: Mezdra Formation may persist OR pass into Kunino/Darmantsi depending on dip

rules.80_100_m: near/below Kaylaka base depending on local thickness
rules.100_200_m: older Maastrichtian formations expected; structural position required

SOUTH_MEZDRA_SYNCLINE_MORAVITSA_CONTROL.first_20_m: Upper Cretaceous carbonate-siliciclastic sequence may be traversed completely locally
SOUTH_MEZDRA_SYNCLINE_MORAVITSA_CONTROL.below: Roman Formation sandstone and/or Sumer marl

structural_guards: Apply local measured thickness only where spatially justified.
Project contacts with dip only when dip is known.
Never interpolate straight through a thrust.
Never assume symmetric preservation between syncline limbs.
Never convert stratigraphic thickness directly to vertical depth without structural orientation.
Kaylaka preservation may differ between limbs.

fallback_output_when_structure_unknown.note: Do not select one formation solely from depth. Surface polygon, tectonic block and fold position are required.

required_resolution_order: local named model if spatially justified
never_do: treat municipality polygon as geological polygon
treat formation thickness as local depth
apply local profile across an entire municipality
force a single lithology where source model is conditional
